title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Purpose:
To ensure the accurate and timely processing of payroll, maintaining employee records and ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and company policies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Process payroll accurately and on time.
- Maintain employee payroll records, including starters, leavers, and changes.
- Calculate statutory payments, deductions, pensions, and benefits.
- Respond to payroll queries from employees and managers.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC and payroll regulations.
- Produce payroll reports and support audits.

Skills & Experience:
- Previous payroll administration experience.
- Good understanding of payroll legislation and statutory payments.
- Strong numerical and administrative skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and payroll systems.
- High attention to detail and confidentiality.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.

Qualifications:
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English.
- Payroll qualification (e.g., CIPP) desirable.

We are happy to provide application and/or accessibility support, please contact your Marks Sattin or Grafton consultant directly to discuss your needs. We're committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients, please visit and for our privacy policy.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk
Location: Doncaster
Salary: Up to £30,000 depending on experience

Elevation Recruitment Group is recruiting for a Purchase Ledger Clerk to join an established business in Doncaster.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced purchase ledger professional to join a supportive team, taking responsibility for accurate invoice processing, supplier reconciliations and maintaining financial records.

The Role
- Process and verify supplier invoices, ensuring correct authorisation.
- Match invoices against purchase orders and goods received notes.
- Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies and supplier queries.
- Reconcile supplier statements and purchase ledger accounts.
- Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
- Support month-end and year-end processes.
- Assist with inventory and purchase ledger reconciliations.

About You
- At least two years' experience in purchase ledger or a similar accounts role.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £30,000, depending on experience.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Pension scheme and staff discounts.
- Career development opportunities.
- Supportive team environment.

If you have purchase ledger experience and are looking for your next opportunity in Doncaster, apply today to find out more.

title: Admin Assistant/Receptionist
company: Rotherham Doncaster and South Humber NHSFT
advertiser_name: Rotherham Doncaster and South Humber NHSFT
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, friendly candidate to join our Talking Therapies administrative team to beresponsible for providing an efficient and professional booking and scheduling service, ensuring appointments, meetings, clinics, and resources are arranged accurately and in a timely manner. The post holder acts as a key point of contact for service users, patients, clinicians, and other professionals, helping to maintain smooth operational delivery and a positive customer experience. The post holder will regularly communicate with: Patients and service users Clinical teams and practitioners Administrative and managerial staff External organisations Members of the public Previous experience of working in the NHS or other large public sector organisation and using an electronic records system i.e. SystmOne would be desirable. This post will be based at either our Scunthorpe, Rotherham or Doncaster site dependant on the suitable candidate. Remote working is supported. Schedule, amend, and cancel appointments using electronic booking systems. Manage clinician, service, and room availability to maximise capacity and utilisation. Contact patients, service users, staff, and external agencies regarding appointment arrangements. Ensure accurate recording and maintenance of information on patient administration systems and databases. Process referrals and bookings in line with service procedures. Monitor waiting lists and highlight potential delays or capacity issues. Prepare appointment letters, confirmations, and related correspondence. Respond to telephone calls, emails, and enquiries professionally and courteously. Maintain confidential records in accordance with GDPR, NHS policies, and information governance requirements. Escalate booking issues, cancellations, or service concerns to the appropriate manager. Support administrative functions including filing, scanning, data entry, and report production. Before applying, please view the attached job description and person specification to view the full details about the role. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if there are a high amount of applications
